title: Distance vs Displacement
subject: Physics
objective: Distance counts the whole path you walked; displacement only looks at the straight line from start to end, with its direction.

fill.q: Distance is the total ____ length travelled.
Displacement is the shortest straight line from start to ____, with direction.
Distance is a ____ quantity; displacement is a ____ quantity.
If you return to your starting point, your displacement is ____.

tf.q: Displacement can be greater than distance.
Distance and displacement are equal for straight-line motion in one direction.
tf.explain: The path is the straight line itself.
Its sign shows direction along the chosen axis.

tf.q: Distance can be zero for a moving object.
tf.explain: A moving object always covers some path.

ar.a: Displacement can be zero even when distance is not.
ar.r: Displacement depends only on the start and end points.
ar.explain: A round trip ends where it began; R explains it.
A is false (distance is a scalar); R is true.

mcq.q: A runner completes one full lap of a 400 m track. Displacement is:
mcq.explain: Start and end are the same point.

mcq.q: You walk 3 m east, then 4 m north. Displacement is:
You walk 6 m forward and 2 m back. Distance and displacement are:

num.q: A boy walks 40 m east and then 30 m north. Find his distance and displacement.
num.answer: Distance 70 m; displacement 50 m towards the north-east

num.q: A particle goes once around a circle of radius 7 m. Find distance and displacement after one full round and after half a round.

short.q: Give two differences between distance and displacement.
short.solution: Distance is total path length and a scalar; displacement is start-to-end straight line and a vector. Distance is never zero for a moving object; displacement can be zero for a round trip.

short.q: A car goes 10 km north then 10 km south. Find distance and displacement.
short.solution: Distance = 20 km. Displacement = 0, because it ends where it started.

left: Straight line start to end with direction
match.explain: Distance counts every step; displacement only compares start and end.
